summary.short: Decree 13.065/2026 amends Decree 10.615/2021 on the PADIS semiconductor programme and regulates Law 14.968/2024 by establishing the Brasil Semicon programme, a governing council, PADIS tax reductions, R&D investment duties, reporting and sanctions for habilitated firms. It concerns semiconductor industrial policy and contains no AI-specific provisions.
summary.long: Decree No. 13.065 of 15 July 2026 amends Decree No. 10.615/2021, which regulates the PADIS semiconductor industry development programme under Law 11.484/2007, and regulates Art. 3 of Law 14.968/2024 to set up the Brasil Semicon programme. It states the programme's objective (components, displays and solar panels), its axes and guidelines, and creates a Brasil Semicon Management Council chaired by the Ministry of Development, Industry, Trade and Services, with a monitoring and reporting cycle. Firms habilitated to PADIS, through acts of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation, receive reductions to zero of federal taxes (PIS/Pasep, Cofins, IPI, import duty, AFRMM, IRPJ and CSLL) on listed equipment, software, inputs, technology payments and services, and a financial credit calculated on R&D spending (multiplier 2.62, capped at 13.10% of the investment base). Beneficiaries must invest at least 5% of gross revenue in R&D and file annual compliance statements and independently audited reports. Sanctions include suspension and cancellation of benefits, with an appeal to the ministry within thirty days. Some benefit provisions apply until 31 December 2029. The decree does not refer to artificial intelligence. It takes effect on the date of publication.
